request: i want to make a change to how we perceive important tasks. How does important tasks work right now?

questions.ask: Right now there's no concept of "important" at all — every task just has a title and a done/not-done checkbox. Should we add a simple on/off "important" flag (like a star you toggle), or something with levels (e.g. low/medium/high priority)?
questions.why: Determines whether we add a single boolean column and star toggle, or a multi-level priority field with a picker UI — very different amount of work and UI design.

questions.ask: Once a task is marked important, what should actually happen to it in the list — should it just get a visual marker (like a star icon) next to it, or should it move/sort to the top of the list, or both?
questions.why: Determines whether we need to change the sort order returned by the app in addition to adding a visual indicator.

questions.ask: Should there be a way to view only the important tasks (a filter or separate view), or is showing them marked within the single existing list enough for now?
questions.why: Determines whether we need to add filter controls/UI beyond the existing single task list page.

findings.note: Tasks table has only id, title, done — no importance/priority column exists today.
API is minimal: GET/POST /api/tasks and PATCH /api/tasks/:id (only toggles done). No importance field is read, written, or used for sorting (list is ordered by id).
UI is a single unstyled list with a checkbox and title per task; no priority/star controls or filters exist anywhere in the app.

reply: introduce concept of important tasks i will go with your recommendation on the implementation

spec.title: Add toggleable important flag to tasks
spec.summary: Introduce a simple on/off 'important' flag per task, toggled via a star control, shown as a visual marker in the existing task list.
acceptance: Each task in the list has a star (or equivalent) control that toggles its important status
Toggling the star updates the task's importance via the API and persists it in the database
Important tasks display a distinct visual marker (e.g. filled vs. outline star) in the list
Reloading the page preserves each task's important state
unchanged: Task list ordering stays as-is (by id); important tasks do not move or sort to the top
No separate filter or view is added for important tasks — they remain shown within the single existing list
Existing done/not-done checkbox behavior and API endpoints for it are unaffected
spec.check: Automated check must prove that toggling a task's important flag via the UI/API persists (survives reload / is stored in the DB) and that the important marker renders correctly for both important and non-important tasks, without altering list order or introducing a filtered view.
spec.reviewFocus: Confirm the implementation stays scoped to a boolean flag with a visual marker only — no reordering/sorting logic and no filter/view were added beyond what was agreed.
